Indian Companies Announce Q2 Financial Results, NTPC Profit Surges

Several Indian companies, including ITC, Marico, UPL, Petronet LNG, NLC, DOMS, Escorts Kubota, NALCO, MobiKwik, and Wockhardt, were scheduled to announce their Q2 financial results on Monday, November 2, 2026. ITC's board of directors met to consider and approve the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. In related news, NTPC reported a 41% jump in its net profit to Rs 7,351 crore for the second quarter, attributing the surge to increased power demand driven by El Niño-induced heat. NTPC also declared a dividend.
